name: itecs-ncentral-rest
description: Read-only self-hosted N-central REST inventory using existing technician identities.

interface.longDescription: Native read-only customer/device inventory tools for self-hosted N-central. Uses a command-backed User-API JWT from the existing technician account. No SSO migration or duplicate login required.
defaultPrompt: Look up customers and devices on our self-hosted N-central server.
